'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***[[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland Defense Forces]] take full control of the strategic Wangable Well in the northern [[Qandala]] [[Qandala District|district]], [[Bari Region|Bari region]], [[Puntland]] from [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIS]], which had served as a base for the group’s senior leaders, militants, and their families. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pakistan floods]]
**Five people are killed when a [[Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa|Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government]] [[Mil Mi-17]] helicopter crashes in bad weather while carrying relief goods to rain-affected areas of [[Bajaur District]] in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/pakistans-monsoon-fury-5-dead-after-rescue-helicopter-crashed-day-of-mourning-announced/articleshow/123322712.cms (''The Times of India'')]
**At least 189 people are killed, dozens are injured, dozens are reported missing, and structures are damaged and destroyed in [[flooding]] across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1931033 (''Dawn'')] [https://www.euronews.com/2025/08/15/flash-floods-in-india-and-pakistan-kill-over-200-people-scores-remain-missing (Euronews)]
*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The first [[hurricane]] of the [[2025 Atlantic hurricane season|2025 season]], [[Hurricane Erin (2025)|Hurricane Erin]], forms near the [[Leeward Islands]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/hurricane-erin-track-path/ (CBS News)]
*[[2025 Lesnoy factory explosion]]
**Eleven people are killed and 130 others are injured in an explosion and fire at a [[powder mill|gunpowder plant]] in [[Shilovsky District]], [[Ryazan Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-fire-at-a-russian-industrial-plant-kills-11-and-injures-130/ (CTV News)] [https://kyivindependent.com/explosion-at-russian-gunpowder-plant-leaves-5-dead-20-injured/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*Eighteen people are killed and nine others are injured when a bus plunges into a valley in [[Algiers]], [[Algeria]]. [https://www.bna.bh/en/Algeriabuscrashkills18injures9.aspx?cms=q8FmFJgiscL2fwIzON1%2BDoU0MlJVGzDBzb4vD2fENrQ%3D (Bahrain News Agency)]
*A bus collides with a stationary truck in [[Bardhaman]], [[West Bengal]], [[India]], killing ten people and injuring 35 others. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/10-bihar-pilgrims-dead-35-injured-as-bus-rams-truck-in-west-bengal-s-burdwan-101755241239162.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*One person is killed and 27 others are injured, including two airlifted, when a train collides with a slurry tanker on a [[level crossing]] and derails between [[Tinglev]] and [[Sønderborg]] in the [[Region of Southern Denmark]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx235yjk3mmo (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The leaders of [[Belize]], [[Guatemala]], and [[Mexico]] announce the establishment of a tri-national [[nature reserve]] to preserve the [[Maya Forest]]. It will be the second-largest nature reserve in [[Latin America]] behind the [[Amazon rainforest]]. ***[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] travels to [[Alaska]] to meet with [[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] to discuss pathways to bring an end to the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gwangbokjeol]], [[2025 South Korean presidential election]]
**[[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Lee Jae Myung]] holds a "''de facto''" inauguration ceremony, known as the "People's Mandate Ceremony", coinciding with the 80th anniversary of [[National Liberation Day of Korea|Korea's liberation from Japan]] at [[Gwanghwamun Square]] in [[Seoul]], where he receives letters of appointment from 80 selected individuals. Lee took office on June 4 after winning the [[2025 South Korean presidential election|21st presidential election]] without an official inauguration ceremony.
